name: Turmeric Powder Herbal 100g Face Pack Remedies acne, blemishes, black heads and dark spots
original_description:
Turmeric Powder Herbal Face Pack – 100g | Traditional Ayurvedic Skincare Ritual

Infused with pure, sun-dried turmeric root and natural Multani Mitti (Fuller’s Earth), this traditional Ayurvedic face pack offers a gentle, earth-inspired cleansing experience. Formulated for daily use, it supports a balanced skincare ritual rooted in centuries-old practices.

Ideal for those who appreciate the calming, grounding qualities of natural botanicals, this blend helps create a soothing pre-cleansing or post-wash experience. The fine texture of turmeric and Multani Mitti works harmoniously to help remove surface impurities and support a refreshed, radiant complexion.

Why This Blend?
- Made with 100% pure, unadulterated turmeric powder and natural Fuller’s Earth
- Gentle exfoliating properties for a smooth skin texture
- Traditionally used in Ayurvedic routines to support skin clarity and natural luminosity
- Free from additives, fragrances, and synthetic preservatives

How to Use:
Mix with rosewater, honey, or yogurt to form a paste. Apply evenly to cleansed skin. Leave on for 10–15 minutes, then rinse gently with lukewarm water. Use 1–2 times weekly as part of your self-care ritual.

Perfect For:
Those drawn to natural, plant-based skincare traditions — especially those seeking a mild, mineral-rich formula to complement daily cleansing.

For external use only. Patch test recommended. Keep out of reach of children.
